newsitem.title: USA: Trism Inc sees Q2 EPS more than $0.09.
newsitem.headline: Trism Inc sees Q2 EPS more than $0.09.

text.p: Trism Inc said Tuesday it expected to report an earnings profit of more than $0.09 per share in the second quarter ending June 30.
Trism reported a loss of $0.59 per share, including a $0.37 special charge, in the first quarter, compared with a loss of $0.38 the year before.
The trucking company reported earnings of $0.09 per share in the second quarter of 1996.
Separately, Trism said it will close a new working capital facility shortly, upping its credit line to $45 million from $25 million.
The company said it will use the proceeds to repay existing working capital debts.
Trism stock closed at 4 Tuesday, down 1/8.
